name: Getchu
summary: Japan's flagship official storefront & database for licensed R-18 PC bishoujo visual novels, doujin goods, and character figures.
ranking_rationale: Authoritative primary source tracking every official Japanese visual novel release date & patch (trade-off: 100% Japanese text interface requiring browser translation outside Japan).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Authoritative primary source tracking every official Japanese visual novel release date & patch
Official digital PC downloads (via partner DL/auth) and collector merch
Trusted over 25 years of Japanese eroge history
cons: 100% Japanese text interface requiring browser translation outside Japan
Strict regional IP checks on certain digital storefront wings
